name: seatbelt
description: Seatbelt skills for people who build apps with AI

plugins.name: seatbelt
plugins.description: A patient senior developer for people who build apps with AI: safe defaults, plain-language pauses at risky moments, a project notebook, and a crash-test readiness grade.

plugins.name: seatbelt-guard
plugins.description: Optional extra: a small program that runs on your computer and stops the AI from committing or pushing a secret key, or from skipping git safety checks. Needs Node.js.
